KAKAROT_RELIC_S_CELL_KEYWORD.title: S-Cells
KAKAROT_RELIC_S_CELL_KEYWORD.description: When you play cards that make you lose HP on purpose (except Kaioken), gain 1 S-Cell per HP lost. At 12 S-Cells, add Transform to your deck and put it into your hand (once per run).
KAKAROT_RELIC_S_CELL_KEYWORD.stats_compe: During a run, this tip shows how many S-Cells you earned this combat and your lifetime total. Numbers are not available in the Compendium.
